summary: We first started off by making the sprites of the game and then dragging them to later code them into Godot, the process was a little bit of a hassle, since some sprites were not aligned correctly and needed to be scaled up some times, we added the hitboxes and an astronaut named John which got his own animations for idle, walking and jumping. After that we implemented the movement code, as well as a currency called Scraps for buying upgrades from the mars shopkeeper, you must get back to your ship at the top by evading some enemies and going on top of platforms.
details:
Its a short platformer where you have to get back to your ship after landing on mars.

We used Godot to code and design the game, for sprites and animations, we use Piskel.

We factored in that it could be simple yet fun game, its a short little adventure that we made with the intention to at the very least leave a tiny mark in someone's journey.
